attr.title: Meg and the Trapper
attr.desc: Meg and the Trapper is a fangame with a double tribute. First to the arcade games of the early 90's like Tumblepop (my favorite) or Snow Bros. And, especially, a tribute to Dead by Daylight reimagining it as a classic arcade.
attr.inst: Download the Meg and the Trapper.zip from https://eltentacle.itch.io/meg-and-the-trapper and extract all game files into assets folder. You can change the player score name by editing "player.txt" located in saves folder.
attr.inst_md: Download the `Meg and the Trapper.zip` from [Itch.io](https://eltentacle.itch.io/meg-and-the-trapper) and extract all game files into `assets` folder. You can change the player score name by editing `player.txt` located in `saves` folder.
